name: Pro shcho tse vzagali?
source:
Immerse yourself in a wildly strange world of wildly strange things and untangle the strange tangle of echoes.

About a world where everything evolves between being and reality, and how strange bits of echo give you clues.

[Translated from [url=https://maxandkon.itch.io/what-is-it-all-about]itch.io[/url]]
